author: malpeet

title: Worth It
body:
After humming and hawing for about a year on whether I should try this app I finally downloaded it. I checked out a guided task First and enjoyed editing my videos along side Rox and’s Rich. I figured I wanted to try the lives so I bought a month worth since it’s only $7 CAD or something like that and if I don’t enjoy it at least it’s not too much money but it’s still investing in my mental health.
Dubbii is different from other productivity apps because it’s a community of people with the goal of completing tasks. The lives are guided by hosts who keep the community safe and on task. With consent they will offer count downs for folks who ask and need an extra boost off the couch. The lives have a pomodoro timer and/or power hour that the hosts call out for those who enjoy that structure but you don’t have to follow that if you don’t want to. 
Each host has their own energy so if you don’t vibe with the first live you join don’t give up and try another. 
It was a bit confusing for me at first but I kept to it and I’ve got so much work done that I have time for myself in the evenings where I can do what I want guilt free!
The best part is Rox and Rich are neurodivergent themselves and they built the app with the community in mind and with their input as well. They find the apps that make it difficult to cancel predatory on neurodivergent minds so if you don’t find it useful it is easy to cancel your subscription. 
Might as well check it out, I would suggest giving Dubbii a chance because this app has been life changing for me and so many others. What have you got to lose?
author: Cdavis986

title: Best app ever!
body: So I’m only on day 2 of using this, I normally hate Zoom calls even with people I know and like and couldn’t understand how this would help, but I was so desperate to break out of my freeze state and get some urgent work done (that I had months to accomplish, naturally) I signed up for a few services but I remembered how much I enjoy the ADHD love channel and decided to give this a shot. I’m only 3 live sessions in but it’s incredible how much I’ve accomplished now! I can’t believe the amount of work I can do even though I’m sleep deprived. My anxiety about an upcoming vacation has almost completely disappeared because I know I can actually apply myself and get it done now. Thank you so much! I never want to be without this app!!!!
author: Leahd1992

title: AMAZING APP!!!!!!
body:
As a teen with ADHD, I constantly am struggling with executive functioning, emotional regulation, and staying on task. This app has helped me SO MUCH!!! 

I have been unable to clean my room for months-as you can imagine, it became really bad. This app has provided so much support and I’m so grateful that it exists as a resource.

body: As an ADHD teenager, this is a wonderful concept and an amazing app. I really just wish there were more free doubling videos as someone who does not have a job and who is a teen teenager. I just wish there was an app that I wouldn’t have to pay for.
author: Lily4525

title: Life changing
body: This app has changed my life. I have always been insecure about my struggles with cleaning and organizing. Rox and Rich give so much compassion and amazing advice to make these tasks a little easier. I’ve started building more positive habits and when I’m struggling the most this app helps lift me up.
author: HS4352

title: Love this app
body:
This app helped me to organize my life. My life has been very messy. Even though I am a task oriented person (I could successfully manage to study and receive my PhD) but it has been absolutely challenging. Not being organized and doing everything the last second under extreme stress makes life unbearable. 
I’m still practicing taking the initiative and using the app, but whenever I do things become simple. This brings me to my request/question. I just hope you would have some advice about taking initiatives like deciding to go to the gym.

title: Already laughing and motivated
body: :D love you two! I had some hopes for the app after keeping up with your YouTube and hearing about it. But here I am having downloaded it and tried the free preview of room of doom and it’s SO good! Rich has me laughing all the time, Rox is painfully relatable of course and love the validation that comes from knowing I’m not the only one to think/feel that way. The music choices are too much to not laugh and love, the frantic fast pace music down to the chill calm vibes, all great picks! Easy choice to sign up for the paid version, both for me to get things done and also to support some amazing humans doing wonderful things for us <3

title: Been dreaming of this for decades !
body: I’m in my 40s and have been begging everyone I know to “body” with me (what I called it), for literally 20 years. So much rejection, judgmental looks, and comments like “shouldn’t you be able to do that yourself”. Super helpful… Anyways, Thanks Rich and Rox for not only making this app but for showing me how many people out there are just like me, and that I’m perfect the way I am. Literally a dream come true after decades in the dark
